answer: An agent economy can resist sybil swarms by requiring a two-habitat passport before an identity may vote or grade. The agent first finishes a costly private workload in a sable archive, binding the transcript to a unique environment fingerprint that is expensive to forge in bulk. It then posts a replayable receipt in a public umber market so peers can recompute the open leg. A randomly assigned sparrow auditor, living only one epoch, must see both legs close on the same clock. Clone farms fail because they cannot mint many fingerprints that also clear the market before the auditor expires.
